Integration note for Manifest V3:
The original v3.10.1 browser build embedded in Gerenciador_Organizador_HTML_Unico_v1.0.9.html contains a legacy setImmediate fallback that accepts a string callback through new Function. The Organizador uses only function callbacks. The packaged runtime keeps JSZip 3.10.1 and removes only that unused dynamic-code fallback so the extension contains no eval or new Function. The original upstream bytes remain preserved inside ORGANIZADOR_ORIGINAL_V1.0.9.html, and both hashes are recorded in ORGANIZADOR_FONTE_V1.0.9_SHA256.json.
